status: baseline — thresholds from published definitions; aggregation weights are NOT validated

composite_index.description: Ranking/trend index only. Not a probability. Data reliability is excluded by design.

destination.required_for_category: at least one primary factor available

journey.access_bands_note: 60 min: trauma 'golden hour' convention; 120 min: Lancet Commission on Global Surgery 2-hour access benchmark

critical_override.description: A verified red alert (GDACS red / USGS PAGER red) affecting the location or route forces CRITICAL regardless of other factors.

history.usgs_min_magnitude_note: USGS 'strong' magnitude class (>= 6): damaging shaking possible at tens of km

ml_gate.note: Acceptance policy: an ML signal is shown only if, on the held-out-location 2024 test set, PR-AUC is at least 3x the prevalence and recall at the validation-chosen threshold is at least 0.5. It never sets the risk category.
